import os
import re
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query, Response, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

app = FastAPI()

TAG_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9]{1,30}$")


class NoteCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str
    body: str = ""
    tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class NoteOut(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    body: str
    created_at: str
    tags: List[str]


def get_db_path() -> str:
    return os.getenv("NOTES_DB", "notes.db")


def get_connection() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(get_db_path())
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


def utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def raise_422(detail: str) -> None:
    raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, detail=detail)


def validate_title(title: str) -> None:
    if not (1 <= len(title) <= 120):
        raise_422("title must be between 1 and 120 characters")


def validate_tags(tags: List[str]) -> None:
    for tag in tags:
        if not TAG_PATTERN.fullmatch(tag):
            raise_422("each tag must be 1-30 lowercase letters or digits")


def fetch_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> Optional[dict]:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None

    tag_rows = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT t.name
        FROM tags t
        JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.tag_id = t.id
        WHERE nt.note_id = ?
        ORDER BY t.name
        """,
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchall()

    return {
        "id": row["id"],
        "title": row["title"],
        "body": row["body"],
        "created_at": row["created_at"],
        "tags": [r["name"] for r in tag_rows],
    }


@app.on_event("startup")
def startup() -> None:
    schema_path = Path(__file__).with_name("schema.sql")
    schema_sql = schema_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    with get_connection() as conn:
        conn.executescript(schema_sql)


@app.post("/notes", response_model=NoteOut, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_note(note: NoteCreate) -> dict:
    validate_title(note.title)
    validate_tags(note.tags)

    unique_tags = list(dict.fromkeys(note.tags))
    created_at = utc_now_iso()

    with get_connection() as conn:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO notes (title, body, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (note.title, note.body, created_at),
        )
        note_id = cur.lastrowid

        for tag in unique_tags:
            conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tags (name) VALUES (?)", (tag,))
            tag_row = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name = ?", (tag,)).fetchone()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO note_tags (note_id, tag_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
                (note_id, tag_row["id"]),
            )

        created = fetch_note(conn, note_id)

    return created


@app.get("/notes/{note_id}", response_model=NoteOut)
def get_note(note_id: int) -> dict:
    with get_connection() as conn:
        note = fetch_note(conn, note_id)
    if note is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="note not found")
    return note


@app.get("/notes", response_model=List[NoteOut])
def list_notes(tag: Optional[str] = Query(default=None)) -> List[dict]:
    if tag is not None and not TAG_PATTERN.fullmatch(tag):
        raise_422("tag must be 1-30 lowercase letters or digits")

    with get_connection() as conn:
        if tag is None:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id FROM notes ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC"
            ).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT n.id
                FROM notes n
                WHERE EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM note_tags nt2
                    JOIN tags t2 ON t2.id = nt2.tag_id
                    WHERE nt2.note_id = n.id AND t2.name = ?
                )
                ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
                """,
                (tag,),
            ).fetchall()

        notes = [fetch_note(conn, row["id"]) for row in rows]

    return [n for n in notes if n is not None]


@app.delete("/notes/{note_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def delete_note(note_id: int) -> Response:
    with get_connection() as conn:
        exists = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)).fetchone()
        if exists is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="note not found")

        conn.execute("DELETE FROM note_tags WHERE note_id = ?", (note_id,))
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,))

    return Response(status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)

import importlib
import sys

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    db_path = tmp_path / "notes_test.db"
    monkeypatch.setenv("NOTES_DB", str(db_path))

    if "app" in sys.modules:
        del sys.modules["app"]

    app_module = importlib.import_module("app")

    with TestClient(app_module.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def create_note(client: TestClient, title="Test note", body="", tags=None):
    payload = {"title": title, "body": body}
    if tags is not None:
        payload["tags"] = tags
    response = client.post("/notes", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 201
    return response.json()


def test_create_note_without_tags(client):
    note = create_note(client, title="No tags", body="Just text")

    assert isinstance(note["id"], int)
    assert note["title"] == "No tags"
    assert note["body"] == "Just text"
    assert note["tags"] == []
    assert isinstance(note["created_at"], str)
    assert "T" in note["created_at"]


def test_create_note_with_tags(client):
    note = create_note(client, title="Tagged", body="Tagged body", tags=["work", "todo"])

    assert note["title"] == "Tagged"
    assert note["body"] == "Tagged body"
    assert set(note["tags"]) == {"work", "todo"}


def test_get_note_by_id(client):
    created = create_note(client, title="Fetch me", body="hello", tags=["one"])

    response = client.get(f"/notes/{created['id']}")
    assert response.status_code == 200

    note = response.json()
    assert note["id"] == created["id"]
    assert note["title"] == "Fetch me"
    assert note["body"] == "hello"
    assert note["tags"] == ["one"]


def test_list_notes_all_newest_first(client):
    first = create_note(client, title="First", body="1", tags=["alpha"])
    second = create_note(client, title="Second", body="2", tags=["beta"])

    response = client.get("/notes")
    assert response.status_code == 200

    notes = response.json()
    assert isinstance(notes, list)
    assert [n["id"] for n in notes] == [second["id"], first["id"]]


def test_list_notes_by_tag_newest_first(client):
    older_blue = create_note(client, title="Older blue", body="", tags=["blue"])
    create_note(client, title="Red only", body="", tags=["red"])
    newer_blue = create_note(client, title="Newer blue", body="", tags=["blue", "red"])

    response = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "blue"})
    assert response.status_code == 200

    notes = response.json()
    assert [n["id"] for n in notes] == [newer_blue["id"], older_blue["id"]]
    assert all("blue" in n["tags"] for n in notes)


def test_delete_note(client):
    created = create_note(client, title="Delete me", body="soon", tags=["tmp"])

    delete_response = client.delete(f"/notes/{created['id']}")
    assert delete_response.status_code == 204

    get_response = client.get(f"/notes/{created['id']}")
    assert get_response.status_code == 404


def test_404_cases(client):
    assert client.get("/notes/999999").status_code == 404
    assert client.delete("/notes/999999").status_code == 404


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_title", ["", "x" * 121])
def test_422_bad_title(client, bad_title):
    response = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": bad_title, "body": "body", "tags": ["ok"]},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 422

)

    response = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "Valid title", "body": "body", "tags": bad_tags},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 422
